title: Government Notifies 100% FDI in Insurance Companies Under Automatic Route
summary: Ministry of Finance notifies FEMA Non-debt Instruments 2nd Amendment Rules 2026, allowing 100% FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) in insurance sector (LIC capped at 20%).

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Government Notifies 100% FDI in Insurance Companies Under Automatic Route. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Ministry of Finance notified amendments to Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules 2019, permitting **100% FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) under automatic route** in insurance companies and intermediaries (brokers), while LIC remains capped at 20%.
